text:
infra-oncall: :rotating_light: Alert: gpu-pool-saturation spike in us-west1-a. Autoscaler attempted scale-ups but instances are stuck provisioning (0/8 after 90s). Spike started ~1971234500. Anyone oncall?

mike: On it. Looking at cloud console — create instance API returning 503s for a bunch of recent calls. Quota looks fine.

deepa: Seeing long boot times, image pulls + startup scripts taking >2m. kubectl describe shows ContainerRuntimeInitTimeout on several nodes.

ryan: Traffic is already drifting to eu-west1 by our router, but only ~10%. I'll bump a small percentage to eu-west to relieve us-west.

sara: Can we manually add capacity to dedicated pools in us-central as an emergency?

infra-oncall: Doing manual scale: +4 GPUs to dedicated-us-central; also disabling scale-to-zero on inference-prod for the moment.

mike: Provider status page: "Compute API degraded — affecting instance creation in us-west1". Opening ticket with provider support now.

ops-bot: incidents: created ticket PROVIDER-9342 for us-west1 compute API errors.

deepa: To reduce pressure, switching traffic to smaller model variant in-region (gpt-small-quant) for most low-latency routes.

ryan: Applied temporary routing: `redwoodctl route adjust --service=inference --region=eu-west1 --weight=0.25` (ran at 1971234620).

mike: Noticed autoscaler thrash — many short launches followed by evictions. Suspect provider hpa timeouts + kube eviction. Increasing provisioner grace and cold pool hold.

deepa: Pushing autoscaler config tweak: change scaleUpCooldown from 30s -> 120s and minUnreadyDuration to 3m. Patch: ```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
data:
  scaleUpCooldown: "120s"
  minUnreadyDuration: "3m"
```
Applying via `kubectl apply -f autoscaler-config.yaml`.

ryan: Don't restart provisioner yet, we risk losing in-flight launches. Monitoring boot latencies first.

infra-oncall: Also enabled a fallback policy: route 10% to eu-west1 permanently until provider fixes. Manual scale +4 in us-central completed at 1971234675.

sara: Heads up for finance — manual bursts + cross-region traffic will add cost for this incident. @finance please expect a one-off usage bump.

mike: Provider support replied: investigating API rate-limiting due to control-plane maintenance, ETA ~20m. ETA is best-effort.

deepa: Adding an instrumentation span to measure instance-create latency in the provisioner. Logs show repeated `provisioner.create_instance -> 502` entries around 1971234630.

prometheus-bot: ALERT RESOLVED: gpu_pool_saturation us-west1 at 1971234730 — metric returned below threshold.

infra-oncall: Queue depth down to normal, average latency dropped back to SLO. Keeping 10% traffic to eu-west and the autoscaler cooldown changes for next 2 hours. Thanks for the quick triage :tada:

mike: I'll follow up with provider ticket and attach timeline + debug logs. We should run a postmortem if provider confirms control-plane maintenance caused it.

deepa: Agreed — also propose an autoscaler hardening doc: detect provider-side create failures and backoff more aggressively to avoid thrash.

infra-oncall: Marking this thread for follow-up. Closing once we confirm billing/cost impact and file action items. Thanks all.
